text:
olivia: Quick sync — embeddings endpoint prioritization handoff. Customers are asking for 4096 dims + big batch support. Need a short, actionable scope for M1. What are the tradeoffs?

raj: TL;DR: support variable dims (512/1024/1536/2048/4096), but require uniform dim per request. Server-side batching up to 1k vectors is feasible technically, start with lower GA limits.

sam: Constraints: GPU memory + RPC payloads. Example: 1k vectors * 1536 dims * 2 bytes (fp16) ~ 3MB payload, 4096 dims -> ~8MB. Memory and kv-cache pressure on serving nodes.

tess: Proposal for M1: default model dim=1536, hosted GA batch_limit=256, dedicated supports 1024+, optional 4096 behind dedicated/enterprise flag.

marco: API shape idea: return array of embeddings with per-item metadata. Minimal response: [{"embedding": [...], "model": "rwd-embed-1536", "dim": 1536, "processing_ms": 12}]. Keep backwards-compatible: if client omits dim param -> use model default.

olivia: Customer question: mixed-dimensions in same request (some items 1536, some 4096) — do we accept?

raj: Runtime complexity too high. Require single-dim-per-request. If mixed dims are needed, clients must split calls. Add explicit error E_DIM_MISMATCH with guidance.

julie: Launch checklist (draft):
- perf: p95 latency <200ms for batch<=8 on hosted small model
- throughput: able to sustain 500rps on a dedicated pool sizing test
- correctness: cosine similarity within ±0.01 vs reference vectors
- infra: autoscaling + healthchecks exercised
- docs: SDK examples for JS/Python + migration guide
- evals: retrieval/recall tests on at least 3 customer-like datasets

tess: Also need stability tests for clustering across dims and deterministic seeding for embeddings (seeded models).

sam: Payload format: support two encodings — raw float list and compressed base64 float16 (default). Param name: encoding = ["raw", "base64_fp16"]. This reduces bandwidth for large batches.

marco: Error semantics: return per-item error field for partial failures (e.g., if one item exceeds length), and overall status. Example: {"items": [{"index":0,"embedding": [...]}], "errors": [{"index":3,"code":"ERR_TOO_LONG","msg":"text > 10k chars"}]}

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: embeddings-service/v2 -> canary tomorrow 03:00 UTC

olivia: Rollout plan: canary 10% + opt-in customers for 4096. After 6h regression checks -> ramp 25/50/100. If regression detected, auto-fallback to legacy model and rollback playbook.

raj: I'll own runtime spec: batching behavior, memory accounting, E_DIM_MISMATCH, and telemetry events (vectors_returned, dims, model_used, processing_ms).

tess: QA: I'll own perf regressions, correctness harness, and customer e2e tests. Need a test dataset from PMs.

sam: Infra: I'll validate payload limits, k8s tuning for large RPCs, and canary autoscaler policies.

olivia: Great — I'll assemble a one-pager for PM/Eng handoff with owners, timeline, and explicit GA vs Dedicated feature splits. Action items: @raj draft runtime API section, @tess QA plan, @sam infra limits, @marco response schema + examples.

olivia: Quick example to include in the doc (response v1):
```json
{
  "request_id":"r_01F...",
  "model":"rwd-embed-1536",
  "encoding":"base64_fp16",
  "items":[
    {"index":0,"embedding":"SGVsbG8...","dim":1536,"processing_ms":11},
    {"index":1,"embedding":"Qm9uam...","dim":1536,"processing_ms":10}
  ],
  "warnings":[]
}
```

raj: That looks good. We'll include an examples appendix for migrations from older APIs.

olivia: Thanks all — I'll turn this thread into the PM brief by EOD and ping for reviews.
